models.last_close: Future closes equal latest close; future MA/BOLL recomputed using history plus these closes.
models.baseline_v1: Existing Java baseline: 20-session close linear-regression slope, median 20-session true range; extend 1-4 days (production currently exposes 3).
models.price_analog: Median observed 1-4 session OHLC paths of 20 nearest historical 10-close normalized shapes; train outcomes must end before the current 10-session observation window.
models.note_analog: Same historical cases and frozen k=20, with an added 0.5 * mean mismatch of MA5/10/20, BOLL, double-high and market direction states drawn from note rule concepts.
models.note_delta1: Indicator parameters only: I[t+h]=I[t]+h*(I[t]-I[t-1]). Source examples imply latest increment continuation. Does not fabricate a close-price forecast.
models.note_delta2: Indicator parameters only: I[t+h]=I[t]+h*(I[t]-I[t-2])/2. Operationalizes 前/昨/今 two-increment average; adjustments based on discretionary phase/rounding are omitted and disclosed.

forecastOrigin: After the final daily close at t; evaluate realized exchange sessions t+1..t+4.
metrics: MA/BOLL MAPE by line and horizon
target vs high or low within 1%

uncertainty.method: paired moving-block bootstrap of error differences

rules: All testable rule events reported, including poor outcomes; not automatically enabled. Filters are not relabeled as directional predictions or complete trading systems.
warnings: One user-chosen stock introduces selection and survivorship limitations.
Current note version and analyst operationalization postdate historical outcomes: retrospective chronological simulation, not actual prospective proof.
No tuning or choosing k/weights on held-out performance.
Today's QFQ vintage is not a point-in-time corporate-action database.
Averages over overlapping 3/4-day forecasts are dependent; confidence bounds use time blocks.
